resources.string: Universal MIUI-style Edge Toolbox for Android
Keeps the edge handle active over other applications
Swipe the edge pill inwards to open toolbox

ExoBoost needs this permission to show the subtle edge handle and floating toolbox on top of games, browsers, and video apps. No screen contents are ever monitored or captured without your explicit trigger.
Required on Android 13+ to maintain the foreground service so the edge handle is not killed by battery optimization.
Detects active application changes and displays the ExoBoost floating toolbox over enabled apps without requiring an ongoing notification.
